risk.label: Risk factor
risk.detail: Systematic sources of return: market, size, momentum, value

MKT.name: Market
MKT.summary: The value-weighted weekly return of the investable crypto market in excess of the risk-free rate.
MKT.description: MKT measures how the whole eligible cryptocurrency market performs relative to the risk-free rate. Every coin that passes the investable-universe filters is weighted by its formation-day market capitalization.
MKT.sort: No sort. One value-weighted market portfolio
MKT.direction: Positive values mean the eligible crypto market beat the risk-free rate that week.
MKT.baseline: Same definition and main construction as the MS baseline. CoinMarketCap history refreshed and sample extended to 2026.

SMB.name: Size
SMB.summary: Small minus big: the smallest 30% of coins by market capitalization minus the largest 30%.
SMB.description: Each week, eligible coins are sorted on the natural log of formation-day market capitalization. SMB is the value-weighted return of the Small portfolio (below the 30th percentile) minus the Big portfolio (above the 70th percentile).
SMB.direction: Positive values mean small coins outperformed big coins.
SMB.baseline: Same 30% / 70% small-minus-big construction as the MS baseline. Data refreshed and sample extended.

MOM.name: Momentum
MOM.summary: Past two-week winners minus losers, controlling for size with a 2×3 independent sort.
MOM.description: The signal is each coin's cumulative return over the past two weeks, with no skipped week. Coins are split independently by the size median and by the 30th / 70th percentiles of the signal. MOM is the average of the two High portfolios minus the average of the two Low portfolios.
MOM.direction: Positive values mean recent winners kept outperforming recent losers the following week.
MOM.baseline: Same past two-week signal, size-controlled 2×3 sort and winner-minus-loser direction as the MS baseline.

MOM3w.name: Momentum (3-week)
MOM3w.summary: A three-week-signal variant of MOM, built exactly the same way. A research extension.
MOM3w.description: MOM3w swaps the two-week signal for the cumulative return over the past three weeks. Everything else is identical to MOM: the 2×3 size-controlled sort, value weighting and the High-minus-Low direction.
MOM3w.direction: Positive values mean three-week winners outperformed three-week losers the following week.
MOM3w.baseline: A new extension. The MS baseline has no exact counterpart.
notes: Research extension. The MS baseline has no exact counterpart, so label it as an extension when you cite it.

M007_GLASSNODE.name: Value (Glassnode)
M007_GLASSNODE.summary: High minus low network usage relative to valuation (active addresses ÷ market cap), using Glassnode addresses.
M007_GLASSNODE.description: Value is network usage relative to market valuation. Coins with many active addresses and a low market capitalization carry a high AA/MCAP signal. Weekly active addresses are Glassnode daily counts summed over the formation week, divided by Sunday market capitalization. A 2×3 size-controlled sort produces the High-minus-Low factor.
M007_GLASSNODE.direction: Positive values mean coins with a high active-address-to-market-cap ratio outperformed those with a low ratio.
M007_GLASSNODE.baseline: Same value idea and 2×3 construction as the MS baseline. Active addresses now come from Glassnode.
notes: Data-source variant of M007_DUNE: same signal, same portfolios. Do not put both in one regression as independent factors.
Coverage starts with the formation week ending 2017-08-06.

M007_DUNE.name: Value (Dune)
M007_DUNE.summary: The same value factor as M007_GLASSNODE, with active addresses sourced from Dune.
M007_DUNE.description: M007_DUNE uses exactly the same portfolio method as M007_GLASSNODE. The only difference is the active-address data, which comes from Dune: weekly sums of daily active addresses divided by Sunday market capitalization, sorted 2×3 within size groups.
M007_DUNE.direction: Positive values mean coins with a high active-address-to-market-cap ratio outperformed those with a low ratio.
M007_DUNE.baseline: Same value idea and 2×3 construction as the MS baseline. Active addresses now come from Dune.
notes: Data-source variant of M007_GLASSNODE: same signal, same portfolios. Do not put both in one regression as independent factors.
Coverage starts with the formation week ending 2017-08-06.

CANCHOR.name: Anchoring
CANCHOR.summary: Coins trading near their 52-week high minus coins far below it: top decile minus bottom decile.
CANCHOR.description: The signal, Nearness52, is the current close divided by the highest close over the past 365 daily observations. Coins at or above the 90th percentile form the High portfolio and coins at or below the 10th percentile form the Low portfolio. The breakpoints are inclusive, so the many coins sitting exactly at their 52-week high stay in High. This release uses the Clean version: a daily return below −100% or above 150% counts as a price break that no weekly return or rolling high may cross.
CANCHOR.direction: Positive values mean coins near their 52-week high outperformed coins far from it.
CANCHOR.baseline: Same signal and High-minus-Low decile construction as the MS baseline. The Clean version adds the extreme-daily-return break rule and resets the rolling history, so it is not just the baseline series extended.
notes: Clean version: extreme daily returns are treated as price breaks, and the 365-day rolling high restarts after each break.

ST.name: Salience
ST.summary: High minus low salience-weighted return signal, following salience theory (θ = 0.10, δ = 0.70).
ST.description: For each coin-day, salience compares the coin's return with the value-weighted market return. Within each coin-week (3–7 valid days), days are ranked by salience and re-weighted with decay δ = 0.70. The ST signal is the salience-weighted mean return minus the plain mean. Coins are split at strict 30th / 70th percentiles, and ST is High minus Low.
ST.direction: Positive values mean the high-signal portfolio outperformed the low-signal portfolio.
ST.baseline: Same core signal and High-minus-Low construction as the MS baseline. Data refreshed and sample extended.
notes: Uses the latest unmodified ST series. It respects known coin-lifecycle breaks but does not apply the Clean CANCHOR daily-return break rule.
